summary.en: Kogoro reveals that he tutored in his youth, and resolves to meet up with one of his students. However, when they go see her, her car suddenly explodes as her sister drives it out of the driveway. Hiromi Tanaka activates the gear switches, which triggers the bomb and the car and explodes it, killing her instantly. Megumi, who was just behind the car, suffers minor injuries. Kogoro is determined to solve the case and find the murderer as soon as possible. At the end, he appears to solve the case, but Conan believes there is a little more to it than the simple explanation he gives.
